role: The byte-array tag, type id 7: length-prefixed raw bytes, used for block entity ids in structure data, skull textures and similar blobs.
scope_reason: Part of the NBT layer behind snapshots and digests.

members.name: byteArray
members.note: Canonical text ba:1,2; empty is ba:.

members.name: func_152446_a
members.note: Reads the length, accounts 8 bytes per element to the size tracker, then readFully.

members.name: toString
members.note: Java's text form: built only by ItemStack.func_151000_E (the item hover in a chat line), CommandGive (chat commands are not agent input) and logging. func_151000_E runs at StatList's init on tagless stacks (id, Count, Damage: a short and a byte) and in a death message only for an item with hasDisplayName (EntityDamageSource, EntityDamageSourceIndirect, CombatTracker), and only the anvil names an item (world.conf anvil = off)

members.name: copy
members.note: Canonical text round trip; Java copies with System.arraycopy, native copies through the parse.

members.name: equals
members.note: NBTTagCompound.equals compares tag values only for ItemStack tags (ItemStack.areItemStackTagsEqual, isItemStackEqual) and a HoverEvent's value; no survival item's tag holds a byte array (ench and StoredEnchantments hold shorts, display.color an int, display.Name and Lore strings, RepairCost an int, Fireworks bytes and int arrays), so it is never compared

notes: Java's write writes the length then the array; native writes the same layout in write_payload's NBT_BYTE_ARRAY case.
